items.title: Larry Ellison Has Lost $145 Billion in Net Worth Over the Past Year as Oracle Stock Fell 59% From Its Peak. Here's Why Oracle's Heavy Concentration in OpenAI Has Wall Street Nervous.
items.summary: Oracle's stock has plummeted 44-50% over the past year, causing founder Larry Ellison to lose approximately $145 billion in net worth. Wall Street is concerned about Oracle's heavy reliance on OpenAI as a customer, with an estimated $300 billion (nearly half) of Oracle's $664 billion backlog coming from OpenAI. While Oracle's cloud segment shows strong 62% growth and the company trades at a reasonable 15x forward earnings, the concentration risk is significant given Oracle's massive $90-95 billion annual capital expenditure commitments funded through debt, creating vulnerability if OpenAI scales back orders.
